concerns.question: What do I call to turn token counts into a USD figure?

detect.note: Matches the ARITHMETIC - a token identifier combined with a rate - not a declaration, a pass-through, or a comment describing it. Earlier drafts flagged five files that merely declare or forward `costPer1KTokens`, two that round to micro-USD (`Math.round(usd * 1_000_000) / 1_000_000`), one converting nanoseconds to milliseconds, and one doc comment. Comments are stripped before matching.
